I had to restart the task because I realized that when I clicked the blue button, it proceeded to the next diagram rather than the next peak. I annotated the second one but then was worried my performance would be evaluated by the lack of annotation on the first graph, so I restarted it. I don't think I could have gotten through 32 but now that I'm familiar with the task, I could do this pretty quickly. 

One other issue is that there is guidance on what constitutes a peak, nor what constitutes the start and end points of a peak. That would have been helpful.
